title: The Effects of Off-Price Store Opening on the Incumbent Channels of a Multichannel Retailer: Full-Line Stores Versus Online Store
eligible_reason: Staggered opening of 10 off-price stores at 7 distinct month-dates (7 customer cohorts); binary treatment = customer lives within 20 miles of a newly opened off-price store; customer-month panel over 15 months; comparison group = not-yet-treated cohorts (no never-treated group). Main estimates are Callaway-Sant'Anna (did R package, doubly robust) aggregated to an overall ATT; Table 10 adds a static TWFE on a market-month panel. CSA estimates condition on three time-invariant customer covariates (age group, income group, distance to nearest full-line store), which is the nonparametric analogue of time-invariant X x time FE; flagged for lead review.
design_notes: Customer (i) x month (t) panel, 13,500 randomly selected existing customers (11,000 treated-group, 2,500 last-cohort comparison in descriptives), 15 months (6 months before first opening through month of last opening). Treatment group g = month in which the off-price store opened in the customer's market (20-mile radius). Not-yet-treated groups serve as controls; all customers eventually treated. Estimator: CS doubly robust with covariates Xi = {age group, income group, distance to full-line store}; SE clustered at customer level via CS multiplier bootstrap. Overall ATT (eq. 1c) = weighted average of ATT(g,t) over t>g with weights proportional to group size (did::aggte, group-size weighting). Event-study by length of exposure (ATTe) is reported only in Web Appendix Figure W6.1, so it is not recorded as a main-text spec. Table 10 is a market x month-year TWFE (10 markets, 150 obs) for ln(number of unique customers). Many Web Appendix robustness specs (W17-W23) are not main text and not recorded.
estimators_reported: Callaway-Sant'Anna (doubly robust, not-yet-treated controls, did R package)

screener_notes: No replication package in our set. Data: individual-level transaction data from an anonymous US high-end department-store retailer under a confidentiality agreement; Web Appendix W24 is a 'replication appendix detailing study design and replication procedures'. JMR Dataverse is restricted by default, so author outreach is required. CSA implemented with R did package (Callaway and Sant'Anna 2021a, v2.1.2), doubly robust, not-yet-treated controls, covariates age group, income group, distance to full-line store (all time-invariant). Lead should confirm that conditional CSA with time-invariant covariates counts as eligible; an unconditional CSA/TWFE counterpart is directly constructible from the same panel. Event-study path by exposure is Web Appendix only (Figure W6.1). Heterogeneity in Tables 6 and 8 is implemented as subsample splits or outcome redefinitions, not as treatment interactions. Table 10 col 1 is the only explicit TWFE regression; 10 market clusters.
